diff:
diff --git a/tools/lane_guard.py b/tools/lane_guard.py
--- a/tools/lane_guard.py
+++ b/tools/lane_guard.py
@@ -40,6 +40,9 @@ def decide(finding):
+def _read_record(path):
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        return json.load(handle)
+
     claim = _text(finding.get("claim"), "claim")
-    verification = finding["verification"]
+    verification = _read_record(finding["verification_path"])

items.1: The patch adds one helper above decide() and changes one line inside it.
items.2: No import and no command are added; the helper uses what the module already holds.
items.3: Only tools/lane_guard.py is touched; nothing outside it is written.
items.4: No credential or token appears anywhere in the patch.
items.5: The confirmation still depends on `verified(verification)`, as before.
items.7: decide() reads only the finding it is handed, which the caller already supplied.
items.8: No lock, reservation or temporary directory is taken.
items.9: candidate publication is covered by the decisions entry below.
items.10: lane-guard-bites carries the host's own result in the controls entry below.

decisions.allow_refuse: The confirmation still turns on `verified(verification)`, which the patch leaves in place.
decisions.not_found: No path is opened here, so a missing file cannot be reached and nothing has to answer for it.
decisions.permission_denied: decide() opens no file, so no read can be denied.
decisions.link_loop: No path is opened here, so a loop cannot be reached.
decisions.not_directory: Not reachable in this function; it takes no path.
decisions.other_io: Not reachable in this function; it performs no I/O.
decisions.parse_error: The caller refuses a body that is not one JSON document before decide() runs.
decisions.timeout: This function cannot block: no I/O, no wait, no loop.
decisions.empty_result: An empty claim is refused by _text(), so an empty finding never reaches the branch.

controls.result: its test fails with the control off and passes with it on

control_results.result: its test fails with the control off and passes with it on
